{{Quote|Perhaps you'll change your '''song''', Greyshade, when you learn '''these''' rebels '''plundered''' and '''destroyed''' a House of Tagge merchant ship-- one delivering ''Wheel'' profits to your '''Inner-Systems Bank!'''|Sector Commander Zertik Strom|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 18">[[Star Wars (1977) 18|''Star Wars'' (1977) 18]]</ref>}}
The '''Inner Systems Bank''' was a financial institution on [[Paigu]].

==History==
This bank was one of many institutions in the [[Commonality]] in which [[Columex/Legends|Columex]] had minority stakes. Profits from the gambling station [[The Wheel/Legends|The ''Wheel'']] were shipped here during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
